tiers.name: core
tiers.meaning: high-frequency and context-budget friendly; not synonymous with read-only

tiers.name: advanced_public
tiers.meaning: general product capabilities for power users, review, merge, import/export, playbooks, and governance

tiers.name: owner_internal_dogfood
tiers.loaded_by: ENGRAM_TOOLS=all plus owner/admin/export gates where applicable
tiers.meaning: local integrations, owner exports, legacy maintenance, full-library import/export, or dogfood surfaces

tiers.name: preview_proposal_only
tiers.meaning: proposal-only previews that do not apply changes or become stable APIs before promotion criteria are met

notable_boundaries.preview_context_governance: advanced owner-gated preview; proposal-only; not stable; not split into four public tools
notable_boundaries.local_tools_registry: local path resolver; do not persist absolute paths into playbooks
notable_boundaries.legacy_playbook_migration: maintenance/dogfood surface, not first-run product story

operator_notes.core_is_not_read_only: Core means high-frequency and context-budget friendly. Core includes local write tools and the owner-gated get_identity_card export surface.
operator_notes.all_tools_mode: ENGRAM_TOOLS=all increases the visible tool list for advanced workflows; it does not bypass governance, owner gates, or public-action confirmation.
operator_notes.preview_tools: Preview context-governance tools return proposal-only evidence and do not apply changes until separately promoted.
operator_notes.public_claims: Client compatibility claims should use L0-L5 evidence labels from docs/runbooks/agent-client-validation.md.

publication_rule: Do not rewrite public launch/listing copy from this taxonomy until owner confirms the release window and public guards are green.
